name: zeffect_anim_load_anim_records
description: zEffect_Anim::LoadAnimRecords restores Anim#### section payloads by entry index, resets active entry chains, and restores tracked Object3D active state and transforms.
binary_ninja_evidence: 0x461670 indexes g_zEffectAnim_EntryList by the payload entryTableIndex and returns only when the resolved entry pointer is null or the entry already has flag 0x4000 set.
When savedActivationState is 1 and the target entry is not already state 1, it converts state 4 to state 3, calls zEffect_Anim::NodeActionCallback, and emits the original reset diagnostic.
It then walks the entry and runtimeSibling chain, calling zEffect_Anim::NodeActionCallback for each non-0x4000 sibling in activationState 2.

For each tracked record it resolves nodeIndex with GameZ_ZBD::NodeIndexToPtr, accepts only Object3D nodes, sets active from activeFlag, skips transform restore when activeFlag is zero, restores a cached matrix when usesCachedMatrix is non-zero, and otherwise restores position, rotation, and scale.
known_limits: code/function tier S byte verification remains deferred to a coherent zEffect animation save/load source-cluster pass.
